name: Casse Artisanal
description: Fondateur des Ferrailleurs bâtissant des colonies entières à partir de déchets créant des avant-postes viables dans les environnements les plus hostiles.

subject.archetype: Casse Artisanal — Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture Epic radiation

loadout.armor_outfit: Vêtements de peaux de vaisseau recyclées avec soudures visibles. Combinaisons tachées d'huile. Masques de soudage. Postures voûtées de travailleurs., refined faction craftsmanship
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's death ability (self_on_flip) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Epic combat manifestation character unleashing their signature ability at maximum power with full body commitment — Death transformation — body shifting on being captured, power released in final burst

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Rusted Orange-Brown
palette_names.role: primary_accent — salvaged metal and oxidized surfaces

palette_names.name: Oil-Slick Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — grease stains and shadowed recesses

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi-source dramatic lighting: primary glow from the ability effect itself, secondary rim light, environmental reflections from below

camera.angle: low extreme angle with wide lens emphasizing the character's dominance over the environment

scenography.setting: Salvage workshop inside a hollowed asteroid, walls lined with repurposed ship parts, welding stations illuminating stacks of sorted scrap metal, improvised machinery
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Welding sparks in bright orange arcs, oil drips pooling on the floor, floating debris in low gravity, steam rising from freshly cut metal, plus final sacrifice — dramatic release of accumulated energy at the moment of defeat visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Fondateur des Ferrailleurs bâtissant des colonies entières à partir de déchets créant des avant-postes viables dans les environnements les plus hostiles.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Les Ferrailleurs vivent dans les champs d'astéroïdes entre les mondes. Ils récupèrent ce que les guerres laissent et construisent à partir de débris.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing with light along the border edges
card_metadata.composition_directive: Wide dramatic shot showing character AND the full environmental scope of their ability's power and reach
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
